row.evidence: Stitch's SSO docs support SAML with Azure AD, Google Workspace, Okta, OneLogin and PingFederate, but "Team members removed from your IdP will still display in the Team members section"; no SCIM page exists in the docs, pricing page or Connect API.
row.notes: New row. Stitch (Stitch Data, now a Qlik/Talend product). None by absence (medium): SAML SSO only, access granted by assigning the IdP app; deprovisioning in the IdP does not remove the Stitch team member, an admin must deactivate them. Pricing is by rows per month, not per user: Standard from $100/mo (monthly; 5 users), Advanced $1,500/mo and Premium $3,000/mo billed annually (unlimited users). Which plans include SSO is not stated on the pricing page or the SSO docs. The Connect API (Advanced+) has no team-member endpoints.

plans.name: Standard
plans.price_text: Starts at $100/month (5M rows/month); monthly or annual
plans.notes: Row-volume pricing (5-300M rows/month); 5 users. Annual price sits behind the billing toggle and was not captured. Connect API not included.

plans.name: Advanced
plans.notes: Unlimited users; Connect API access (no team-member endpoints).

plans.name: Premium
plans.notes: Unlimited users; Connect API access (no team-member endpoints).

scim.notes: False by absence: the docs sitemap (about 43,600 URLs) contains no SCIM page, the SSO guide describes SAML only, and users removed from the IdP stay listed in Stitch until an admin deactivates them.

rate_limits.text: Rate limits apply to endpoints that return large amounts of data or need polling (extractions, loads).

user_api.notes: False by absence: the Connect API (Advanced and Premium, or during the trial) manages accounts, sources, destinations, streams, extractions, loads and notifications; it has no team-member or role endpoints.

okta.notes: Stitch's guide creates a custom SAML app in Okta; no OIN entry (okta.com/integrations/stitch/, /stitch-data/, /stitchdata/ return 404).

entra.notes: Vendor guide for Azure AD SAML; no Microsoft Learn tutorial found (404).

google.notes: Vendor guide for a Google Workspace SAML app.

fallbacks.notes: With SSO on, colleagues get access by being granted the IdP app rather than by a Stitch invite; the docs do not spell out account creation on first sign-in.
